name: Tapestry Warden
clause: Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power stations permanents using its toughness rather than its power.

needs.proposedSignature: activated form `{ op: 'station', target: TargetSpec }` (cost `tapUntappedCreature`), static `{ kind: 'station-thresholds', thresholds: [{ counters: number, types: CardType[], subtypes: string[], power: number, toughness: number, abilities: Ability[] }] }`, and - what this card needs - `{ kind: 'stations-by-toughness', scope: 'you-control' | 'all', onlyWhenGreater?: boolean }`
needs.semantics: Stationing taps an untapped creature you control to put CHARGE counters on a Spacecraft equal to that creature's power; at each printed threshold the Spacecraft gains the listed types, P/T and abilities. Tapestry Warden's static replaces the value used for stationing with the creature's toughness when that is greater - exactly the shape of the existing `damage-by-toughness` static (`scope` + `onlyWhenGreater`), so the natural implementation is a sibling static read by the station cost calculation.
needs.clause: Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power stations permanents using its toughness rather than its power.
